dct_title_s: Spheres of Influence, Placer County, California, 2020
dct_description_sm: This polygon shapefile contains spheres of influence in Placer County, Calfornia. Special district spheres of influence define the probable physical boundaries and service area of a local agency. This layer is part of a collection of public geospatial datasets produced by the Placer County GIS Division.
